why_this_source: Nott et al. 2019 cite Zhang et al. 2016 as the external human brain cell-type RNA-seq expression reference used alongside their epigenomic analyses. Using the same public reference avoids circular use of JEPA discovery RNA, NIH-CARD, or Morabito.
spillover_rule: Do not substitute another brain RNA dataset, a reprocessed copy, brainrnaseq-derived export, SEA-AD/HVS/NPH52 RNA, NIH-CARD, Morabito, or a file with a similar title. P3 expression authority remains blocked until the exact GEO processed file is acquired and hashed.
next_required_step: Acquire exact GSE73721_Human_and_mouse_table.csv.gz bytes from GEO, record size/SHA-256/header, verify which columns correspond to GSM1901339/40/41 and the gene identifier field, then prospectively freeze the microglial expression eligibility rule before reading P3 candidate-gene attrition.
